title: Agent Tool Use and Context Protocols
title_zh: 智能体工具调用与上下文协议
desc: Trace a deterministic agent loop through action selection, schema validation, authorization, tool execution, provenance-aware context updates, and stopping.
desc_zh: 追踪一个确定性智能体循环，观察动作选择、模式验证、授权、工具执行、带来源信息的上下文更新与停止。
featured: Predict whether a proposed action executes, is rejected, is denied, or should stop, then inspect the exact runtime gate.
featured_zh: 先预测一个候选动作会被执行、拒绝、拒绝授权还是应该停止，再检查对应的精确运行时关卡。
course_phase: Agent tool use and runtime protocols
